sources.title: fix(sessions): recover saved peer inputs after restart
sources.mechanism: Omit absent source/target lifecycleRevision in new delivery metadata; legacy replay reconstructs only those two undefined fields and accepts only a complete original hash for the same run. Retained receipt keeps its raw hash through completion. Already consumed/cancelled recovery candidates are checked before endpoint resolution.
sources.acceptance_delta: Require JSON round-trip and database close/reopen identity tests across pending/interrupted/consumed/completed states, identical completed replay returning the recorded outcome without a new turn, changed-content conflict, exact current endpoints/permissions, and a full process restart/second-crash trace before runtime upgrade.
sources.proof_boundary: All 8 immutable merge patches inspected. Added tests use real input/completion owner close/reopen and lifecycle generation rotation; no full OS-process/Gateway restart trace. 95 focused tests are author-reported, not executed here.
sources.ci_boundary: Exact-head CI metadata reports failure. Full 68-job metadata read: check-prod-types, check-lint-core-2, and aggregate openclaw/ci-gate fail. Author claims inherited unused LitContent import and authorized exception; causality/authorization/log attribution not independently audited. No green CI claim.
sources.discussion_boundary: Complete issue 4 / inline 0 arrays fetched. Latest bot review and author landing exception read; bot found no code defect but asked for failed-typecheck attribution and noted absent shipped restart proof. No authoritative thread-resolution query.

sources.title: fix(gateway): bound and attribute suspension drains
sources.mechanism: Drain leases have one absolute 45-second coordinator budget (30-second drain plus 15-second handoff/cleanup); prepare/readiness/poll cannot renew it. Expiry resumes scheduling and admission without cancelling admitted work or dropping writes; committed shutdown remains host-owned. Freeze/snapshot leases retain renewable two-minute TTL. Controller/CLI cap drain to 30 seconds, preserve exact lease identity, and record owner/lease/caller/reason/exit attribution.
sources.acceptance_delta: Require disconnected-controller and attempted-renewal cases, rollback-clock expiry, slow preflight/prepare budgeting, expired/replaced-lease refusal, protected writes, and committed-shutdown ownership. Adopt the matching controller closure separately and demonstrate shipped Gateway/update behavior before runtime upgrade.
sources.proof_boundary: All 18 immutable merge patches inspected, including controller text treated only as evidence. Dispatcher/coordinator/CLI tests and inert transport/virtual clock fixtures; no live suspension, GNU-timeout validation, deployment, or stable-to-candidate update trace. Reported focused counts not executed here.
sources.ci_boundary: Exact-head CI run metadata reports completed/success. No job logs or runtime artifacts independently audited.
sources.discussion_boundary: Complete issue 3 / inline 2 arrays fetched/read, including obsolete slow-preflight finding and author fix reply. Source includes the lease-anchored budgeting and matching tests. Bot notes absent shipped-entry-point proof. No authoritative thread-resolution query.

sources.title: fix: background completion is dropped when the config changes mid-turn
sources.mechanism: Only stale-policy rejected occurrences that never started, attempted no delivery, and were neither aborted nor abandoned receive fresh dispatch under current policy, at most twice. Captured destination/tool ceiling/settings/delivery opt-out and live producer/ingress authority survive; receipt cancellation/settlement forwards to live attempt. Distinct per-attempt MessageSid avoids dedupe loss. Exhaustion/revocation consumes terminally with logs; producer text never falls back to contract-less passive custody. Precheck before admitUserTurn avoids early durable exec-source retirement.
sources.acceptance_delta: Require real deferred exec source identity, new-policy deny, retained producer ceiling with a permissive current policy, allowed-write control, revoked producer, cancellation, publication storm, no later passive drain, and current packaged-Gateway final-effect trace. Isolate publication during admitUserTurn awaits rather than claiming that residual closed.
sources.proof_boundary: All 5 immutable merge patches and full current PR body inspected. Tests use real queue/dispatcher/durable source admission and managed filesystem write effects with synthetic model inference; added real-child exec case skips Windows. Current packaged-Gateway driver was not rerun after restructure and is absent from diff; older packaged traces explicitly historical. No local execution here.
sources.known_residual: Policy publication during admitUserTurn's own awaits may still terminalize durable source before execution rejection, then settles failed with error log. Current body explicitly leaves source-retirement policy outside scope.
sources.ci_boundary: Exact-head CI metadata reports completed/success; head-run listing returns 16 complete workflow records. No job logs or test execution independently audited. Success does not supply missing current packaged-Gateway proof.
sources.discussion_boundary: Complete issue 22 / inline 0 arrays fetched; current latest substantive bot review read in full, historical author replies sampled. Latest review still asks current real-behavior proof despite subsequent merge. No authoritative thread-resolution query.

retained_unreplicated_source_concerns.boundary: Current blob identity to prior inspected source confirmed; neither concern reproduced. No authoritative review-thread resolution queried. Old comments are not new events.
